notes:
Passed on the fake backend by python3 -m mhs.driver check; evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level. Model-authored (driver.lock.json authored_by kind model, run wC-054) and unreviewed (reviewed_by null); no hardware was attached and no hardware run is claimed. The package has no hardware backend: mode simulated, risk R0 (the card floor). SustainDC is a multi-agent Gymnasium simulation benchmark, not a hardware device: SustainDC subclasses gymnasium.Env (sustaindc_env.py:90), EnvConfig defaults to agent_ls, agent_dc and agent_bat (sustaindc_env.py:40), and each agent has a Discrete(3) action space with a Box observation (envs/carbon_ls.py:40-45, utils/make_envs_pyenv.py:114-132, envs/bat_env_fwd_view.py:23-28). There is no gymnasium.register entry: the constructor takes an EnvConfig mapping (sustaindc_env.py:91-99) and the upstream needs gymnasium, numpy, pandas, torch and the workload, weather and carbon-intensity data files, which were not installed or run. The only backend is the package fake (fake.py), which models the three agent keys with a Dict action/observation contract, the upstream observation sizes and bounds, placeholder transitions and a placeholder episode length; its initial states, increments, rewards, info values and 672-tick episode are test data, not facts or limits. DEVIATION FROM THE CARD: none in shape (GymnasiumDriver); the bridge carries one scalar reward (the sum of the three placeholder individual rewards) and one terminated/truncated flag, while upstream returns per-agent reward, termination and truncation dicts, and the fake accepts reset(seed, options) and returns (observation, info) while upstream reset() takes no arguments and returns only the state dict; both are recorded in the fidelity gaps. NOT COVERED: the upstream Time/Workload/Weather/CI managers, the data-center thermal, energy and battery models, the reward methods and the real observation values; the fake was never compared with the upstream environment, and the card's mock_strategy.preferred upstream-sim path was not run. Expected Gymnasium-family warnings only: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (the seed only sets the next reset) and six G8.NO_UNIT for the bridge-derived integer inputs ticks, seed twice and the three action members agent_ls, agent_dc and agent_bat (PLAYBOOK.md section 8); G4 had no REF_VALUE or REF_BINARY warnings. Only catalogue classes (cap.world.reset.v1, cap.world.step.v1 and cap.world.seed.v1) are used, so there are no catalogue requests. gate.digest is the digest line the check printed; check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package.
